completenessNote: 该法规为单篇法律文书，无分节结构；正文按官方 front 抬头逐字全录，共 1 条。

text.en:
Registration of Births and Deaths Act
(Chapter 267)
Appointment of Deputy Registrars
It is hereby notified for general information that, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 3(2) of the Registration of Births and Deaths Act, the Minister for Home Affairs has appointed the following officers to be Deputy Registrars of Births and Deaths for the purposes of the Act, with effect from 17th December 2000:
(1)Commanding Officer, Ang Mo Kio South Neighbourhood Police Centre.
(2)Commanding Officer, Ang Mo Kio North Neighbourhood Police Centre.
(3)Commanding Officer, Hougang Neighbourhood Police Centre.
(4)Commanding Officer, Sembawang Neighbourhood Police Centre.
(5)Commanding Officer, Serangoon Neighbourhood Police Centre.
(6)Commanding Officer, Yishun North Neighbourhood Police Centre.
(7)Commanding Officer, Yishun South Neighbourhood Police Centre.
(8)Commanding Officer, Bedok South Neighbourhood Police Centre.
(9)Commanding Officer, Bedok North Neighbourhood Police Centre.
(10)Commanding Officer, Changi Neighbourhood Police Centre.
(11)Commanding Officer, Geylang Neighbourhood Police Centre.
(12)Commanding Officer, Marine Parade Neighbourhood Police Centre.
(13)Commanding Officer, Pasir Ris Neighbourhood Police Centre.
(14)Commanding Officer, Tampines Neighbourhood Police Centre.
